New decision "RB6 ruled: human rulings are produced only by an interactive signed CLI ceremony the model cannot invoke (TTY required, human key outside any repo), and host-attested literal human prompts are captured as human_statement evidence (unverified authority) that only the ceremony can upgrade; a caller-supplied actor field never confers authority" relates to:
- 01M08Y6N5RVNYHHJNCXCWBN216: "Chose FTS5+BM25 hybrid fusion (new DD-10 'retrieval v2': RRF fusion, sibling-session clustering, record-kind weighting) as THE semantic-matching improvement over an embedding-model swap"
- 01M1RB38V2SEW1010VBZY6EDG3: "Treat field items #3 and #4 as two distinct failure shapes (transport lag → EMPTY sqlite read; old-Node fallback → LOUD ENOENT) and answer them separately rather than under the report's single 'fix is Node' framing"
- 01M1RB38Z75MBP18284TEB6F4K: "Chose disclosure-first for #3 (sync block on twining_status + one-line assemble caveat, local-only git state) over any mechanism that commits or stages records for the operator"
- 01M1RB39AVFHTPZ39Z0NCG2WCF: "Minted three design decisions without building: DD-12 (mutation & conflict model for records/**: status quo vs event-sourced per FOUNDATION-PLAN D2 vs revision stamp + resolver), DD-13 (transport boundary — server process never commits; CLI only on explicit flag), and a DD-6/DD-11 joint question (fallback policy on old Node: refuse knob vs read-only records view)"
- 01M1RB39KS651HNKH4H72EHNKV: "Ingest retention is recorded as a narrow, named exception to DD-8: an unreadable or mis-keyed record file is not a file and cannot 'win'; precedence for parseable files is unchanged"
- 01M2K9813SSVCD2B12PXVMW69Q: "Plan hypothesis (not yet committed): one foundational change — an immutable event log with derived projections — is justified by measured failures of in-place record mutation; Git stays the default transport evolved into an explicit protocol, with a reference relay behind the same Transport interface built but not deployed"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 6 existing decision(s) overlap
